items.title: Morris French Interview
items.q: Handy, he work at Tulane University.

ctx.x: Yeah, some of them wanted to go back. I was talking to a guy today on the bus, Jesse Charles. Says he's trying to come back on clarinet. You saw him today? Yeah, he said he's been intending to phone you up. Said he might could get you a little.
What the old boy used to play so much clarinet that would sing bass at Louis?
Oh, he work at... John Handy. Yeah, he work at Tulane University. John Handy. Yeah. Handy, he work at Tulane University. Yeah. You think he can't play no more?
